budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three estimates were received, one bidder estimated cleaning only and was not considered; two remaining bids were reported as a two-phase project, Phase 2 in FY18, with DPW postponing work to fund FY17 costs, and about 30K in the reserve fund. A preliminary Service Quest estimate was described only as six figures.
budget_items.quote: one bid is for $49k, the other bid is for $51.6k. this will be a two phase project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Salary reserve transfer approved for the town accountant contract and related accounts.
budget_items.quote: mark made a motion to approve the salary reserve transfer of $8259.76 for the longevity account $247.79 cellphone stipend account $480

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three Community Compact grants reported: cyber security assessment, citizen engagement (website revamp), and storm water measures. The minutes print the second as '$1OK' (OCR of $10K).
budget_items.quote: the community compact received three grants: $10k for cyber security assessment

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Grants reported for E-permitting software and for regional animal control facility design.
Policy approved by MassDOT; Lunenburg eligible for up to $50k for technical assistance to plan, and then up to an additional $400K for construction once the plan is submitted.
budget_items.quote: so that makes lunenburg edge able for up to $50k for technical assistants to put together a plan.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Engine 4 damaged by a manhole cover; repairs estimated at 33K with a $1000 deductible; pump overhaul needed after July 1, on the capital plan for replacement.
budget_items.quote: engine 4 damage from manhole cover. 33k in repairs. $1000 deductible.
